name: release-it
description: Michael T. Nygard's Release It! as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, bulkheads, overload control, safe deployment and observability in services, APIs and queues.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Release It! rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
